sentences.en: She even confirmed his voice.
sentences.zh: 她甚至证实了他的声音。

sentences.en: She does recognize his voice when he was speaking.
sentences.zh: 她在他说话时确实认出了他的声音。

sentences.en: Of course I know.
sentences.zh: 我当然知道。

sentences.en: She went on to tell us that he was in fact the third man that had bought her.
sentences.zh: 她接着告诉我们，他实际上是第三个买下她的人。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to ask a sensitive question but can you please tell me and tell this man if he abused you sexually if he raped you in these five months that he held you.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉问一个敏感的问题，但请你告诉我，也告诉这个人，在你被他囚禁的这五个月里，他是否虐待过你，是否强奸过你。

sentences.en: She said yes
sentences.zh: 她说是的

sentences.en: she did
sentences.zh: 她经历过

sentences.en: and I swear to Allah he did.
sentences.zh: 我向真主发誓，他确实做过。

sentences.en: Every two days he would come to me and he would have sex with me.
sentences.zh: 每隔两天他就会来找我，并和我发生性关系。

sentences.en: She said that Bashar was cruel to her.
sentences.zh: 她说巴沙尔对她很残酷。

sentences.en: He says he used to beat me and he used to ask my father for a ransom, that he used to either to give him 10,000 US dollars or he's going to sell her to Syria.
sentences.zh: 他说他过去常常殴打我，并向我父亲索要赎金，他要么索要1万美元，要么就把我卖到叙利亚。

sentences.en: She also said that he did indeed contact her father.
sentences.zh: 她还说他确实联系过她父亲。

sentences.en: He had said that he had done as much, but it wasn't to help her, to rescue her.
sentences.zh: 他曾说他做过这样的事，但不是为了帮她、拯救她。

sentences.en: He was contacting her father to shake him down for a ransom.
sentences.zh: 他联系她父亲是为了勒索赎金。

sentences.en: Did he pray before raping her?
sentences.zh: 他强奸她之前会祈祷吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Please tell her I'm so sorry for what she's experienced and tell her my own mother was raped and she should not feel in any way ashamed by what has happened to her.
sentences.zh: 请告诉她，对于她所经历的一切我感到非常抱歉，并告诉她我自己的母亲也曾被强奸，她不应该为发生在自己身上的事情感到任何羞耻。

sentences.en: It was not her fault.
sentences.zh: 这不是她的错。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Fala.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，法拉。

sentences.en: I'm going to cut the phone now.
sentences.zh: 我现在要挂断电话了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: I'll be in touch, okay?
sentences.zh: 我会保持联系的，好吗？

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bashar.
sentences.zh: 巴沙尔。

sentences.en: Bashar.
sentences.zh: 巴沙尔。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to ask him what he says.
sentences.zh: 现在我想问问他怎么说。

sentences.en: He challenged me yesterday and said to get this girl on the phone, that she would basically recount what he said.
sentences.zh: 他昨天向我发出挑战，说让我把这个女孩找来通电话，说她基本上会复述他的话。

sentences.en: She's saying exactly the opposite.
sentences.zh: 但她说的完全相反。

sentences.en: What is his reaction?
sentences.zh: 他有什么反应？

sentences.en: Bashar swore on the name of God that everything he had done had been for this young girl's good.
sentences.zh: 巴沙尔以真主的名义发誓，他所做的一切都是为了这个小女孩好。

sentences.en: He had done this to save her.
sentences.zh: 他这样做是为了救她。

sentences.en: And he stuck to the story even as pretty much every other part of his story started to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 即使他的故事几乎所有其他部分都开始崩溃，他依然坚持这种说法。

sentences.en: Now he says I'm from Farouk, not from Bab Sinjar.
sentences.zh: 现在他说我来自法鲁克，不是来自巴卜辛贾尔。

sentences.en: From Farouk neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 来自法鲁克街区。

sentences.en: The place that he had joined ISIS changed.
sentences.zh: 他加入 ISIS 的地点变了。

sentences.en: Next to the Grand Nuri Mosque, now he says.
sentences.zh: 现在他说在宏大的努里清真寺旁边。

sentences.en: He admitted that he had held her for five months, not one.
sentences.zh: 他承认他囚禁了她五个月，而不是一个月。

sentences.en: Yesterday it was only one month.
sentences.zh: 昨天还只说了一个月。

sentences.en: The amount of time that he had been in ISIS started to expand.
sentences.zh: 他加入 ISIS 的时间开始拉长。

sentences.en: He's meeting her on some of the details.
sentences.zh: 他在某些细节上与她对不上。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He says, what I'm telling you is all the truth, and that's nothing but the truth.
sentences.zh: 他说，我告诉你的一切都是实话，绝对没有一句假话。

sentences.en: And I'm not contradicting, and I'm not lying to you.
sentences.zh: 我没有自相矛盾，也没有对你撒谎。

sentences.en: And that's what I have.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的情况。

sentences.en: So, Bashar, I'm just a journalist, okay?
sentences.zh: 所以，巴沙尔，我只是个记者，好吗？

sentences.en: I'm not a member of any security force, and I'm not a member of any government.
sentences.zh: 我不是任何安全部队的成员，也不是任何政府的成员。

sentences.en: I'm asking you, do you want to tell me what really happened with this girl, or do you not want to be interviewed at all?
sentences.zh: 我问你，你想告诉我这个女孩身上到底发生了什么，还是你根本不想接受采访？

sentences.en: And after some time, he just stopped answering my questions.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，他不再回答我的问题了。

sentences.en: And at that point, I knew that it was time for us to go.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我知道我们该走了。

sentences.en: So, do you know what happened to Bashar?
sentences.zh: 那么，你知道巴沙尔后来怎么了吗？

sentences.en: So, the jail where we saw him told us that they transferred him to Baghdad, but when we called Baghdad, they have no record of him.
sentences.zh: 我们见到他的那座监狱告诉我们，他们把他转送到了巴格达，但当我们打电话给巴格达时，那里没有任何关于他的记录。

sentences.en: So, I don't actually know what happened to him.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实不知道他到底怎么了。

sentences.en: What we do know for sure is that the Iraqi government is aggressively prosecuting these people, and they're holding trials that are incredibly hasty.
sentences.zh: 我们确切知道的是，伊拉克政府正在积极起诉这些人，而且他们举行的审判速度极快。

sentences.en: And human rights groups have criticized that type of justice, saying that these hasty trials are, first of all, violating the due process of the prisoners,
sentences.zh: 人权组织批评了这种司法形式，称这些仓促的审判首先侵犯了囚犯的正当程序权，

sentences.en: and there's worries that perhaps people who are not ISIS members are being implicated.
sentences.zh: 并且人们担心可能有些并非 ISIS 成员的人也被牵连其中。

sentences.en: But beyond that, they're also saying that this is a violation of the rights of the victims, because they are not being given a chance at closure.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，他们还表示这也是对受害者权利的侵犯，因为受害者没有获得一个了结的机会。

sentences.en: They're not being given a chance to know, to even know what happened to their tormentors.
sentences.zh: 她们甚至没有机会去了解、去弄清楚折磨她们的人到底遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: And in fact, since that phone call that we made in that jail, we've been able to get back in touch with the young girl's father.
sentences.zh: 事实上，自从我们在那座监狱里打完那通电话后，我们就已经重新联系上了那个女孩的父亲。

sentences.en: And he told us that the fact that his daughter was able to confront her rapist in that way was cathartic for her.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，他的女儿能以这种方式直面她的强奸犯，对她来说是一种精神宣泄。

sentences.en: But the fact is, this young girl wouldn't have even known that he was in jail if it weren't for this accident of journalism,
sentences.zh: 但事实是，如果不是因为这次机缘巧合的采访，这个年轻的女孩甚至不会知道他在监狱里，

sentences.en: if it weren't for the fact that a group of New York Times journalists just happened to walk into this prison on this particular day.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为一群《纽约时报》的记者恰好在这一天走进了这座监狱。

sentences.en: So it's possible that she would have thought that he could have just been out roaming the world, living in the world still.
sentences.zh: 所以她完全有可能以为这个人还在外面四处游荡，依然活在这个世界上。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What these men did lives on in the hearts of the women and girls they left behind.
sentences.zh: 这些男人所做的事，永远留在了他们抛下的那些妇女和女孩的心中。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们筹备假期做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
